== Notes for Q976 ==

<b>Cryogladios</b>
<p>("Cryo" for ice, symbolizing Grylloblattodea, and "Gladios" for sword or warrior, reflecting Mantophasmatodea's gladiatorial nature.)<b>Myth of Cryogladios:</b>
<p>In the primordial epoch of <b>Arthropodica</b>, when the world was divided into realms of eternal frost and endless battlefields, the first <b>Cryogladios</b> arose as a child of extremes. Born from the union of <b>Glaciara</b>, the Frost Queen, and <b>Bellatoris</b>, the Warlord of Storms, Cryogladios embodied both resilience against the harshest cold and an unyielding fighting spirit.<b>The Tale of the Twin Realms:</b>
<p>The land of Arthropodica was ruled by two rival forces: the <b>Frozen Expanse</b>, where only the hardiest survived, and the <b>Arena of Eternal Strife</b>, where warriors battled endlessly for supremacy. Cryogladios, caught between these two worlds, sought to bring balance.
<p>1.</p>
<p><b>The Frozen Journey (Grylloblattodea):</b></p>
<p>To prove their worth to Glaciara, Cryogladios embarked on the <b>Frozen Journey</b>, traveling deep into the glacial mountains. They faced storms of biting ice and creatures of frost, learning to endure the unrelenting cold. From this, they gained the ability to survive in the harshest of environments, a trait passed on to their descendants, the <b>Ice Crawlers</b>, who now dwell in icy isolation.
<p>2.</p>
<p><b>The Trial of Blades (Mantophasmatodea):</b></p>
<p>To earn Bellatoris's approval, Cryogladios entered the <b>Arena of Eternal Strife</b>, where they wielded a blade forged from frozen lightning. Facing foes of unmatched skill, they honed their prowess in combat and emerged victorious. This strength was inherited by the <b>Gladiators</b>, who became masters of strategy and battle.<b>The Clash and the Legacy:</b>
<p>Despite their mastery of both worlds, Cryogladios saw the futility of eternal rivalry and sought to unite the realms. They brokered a truce between the Frost Queen and the Warlord of Storms, allowing the two forces to coexist. However, peace came at a cost: Cryogladios was shattered into two essences, each imbued into their offspring.
<p>• From their <b>icy resilience</b>, the <b>Grylloblattodea</b> were born, thriving in frozen, desolate places.
<p>• From their <b>martial spirit</b>, the <b>Mantophasmatodea</b> arose, embodying the unyielding strength of warriors.
<p>To this day, Cryogladios is remembered as the ancestor who bridged two extremes—cold and combat—leaving behind descendants who reflect their dual legacy of survival and strength.
